headline: Wardens Retake Mooring County; Fisherman's Row Work Lies in Ruin
war_summary: Three hours beyond our last edition, the tide in Mooring County has turned: the Warden counterstroke has erased the lone Colonial foothold at The Wind Hills, and all twelve of that region's works fly Warden colors once more. Fisherman's Row, newly fallen to the Colonials, has given up a work to ruin; eight stand in Colonial hands, with fresh action logged to the filing hour. Godcrofts is the war's busiest ground, forty-two base actions in the day and a dozen inside two hours, though the line holds at six Warden works to three. Callahan's Passage remains the costliest field, near 10,000 Colonial and 7,500 Warden losses in the day, the last hour running at roughly 300 apiece and climbing, while Stonecradle resumes its grind after the midnight lull. The Weathered Expanse and Stlican Shelf show no base action these six hours, though Expanse casualties accelerate; the Linn of Mercy, eleven works Colonial, has gone still. The day's count: some 38,000 Colonial and 44,000 Warden dead. The ledger stands at 287 Colonial works to 148 Warden, one in ruin. No victor is declared on Day 233.
